get.description: Lists the public parameter contract derived from current Go model definitions. By default returns model identities and localized labels. include=parameters expands operations, input constraints and parameter rules. The version identifies the complete contract and is the same for compact and expanded responses. Support does not imply current supply availability or an executable quote. No prices or channel details are returned.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Expand public parameter contracts. Other or repeated query parameters are rejected.

get.summary: Get model detail or its versioned parameter contract
get.description: Without query parameters returns the existing Market detail. view=contract requires the canonical creator/model ID and returns its public parameter contract with the same content version as the model list, without querying price or current supply. Aliases may be used in generation requests but are not resource paths.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Returns the public parameter contract; no other query parameters are accepted.

200.description: Model detail or versioned parameter contract

get.summary: Get the current safe snapshot of a job
get.description: A job snapshot stays readable for 90 days from creation, the same window as summary log retention. After that window the endpoint answers 404 exactly as it does for an unknown job id, and the response never discloses which of the two cases applies.

get.summary: Get a lightweight status summary of a job
get.description: Returns a minimal status projection without loading attempts, billing ledgers, or result assets. Follows the same 90-day retention window as job snapshots.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional on the wire. Replaying the same key with an identical standardized request returns the original result instead of creating a second one; reusing a key with a changed request is rejected; a request without a key always creates a new resource. Production integrations should persist one key per logical request before submitting. The TypeScript and Go SDKs require a caller-persisted key instead of generating one, so their callers must supply it.

RoutingOverride.description: Request-scoped routing intent. only is an unordered Provider allowlist; selection and recovery stay within this set and any retained account restrictions. 'official' is accepted as an alias for the model's official provider channel in both only and variants (normalized before execution). A single item supports targeted testing. Custom order is not supported. preference and fallback remain optional.

variants.description: Provider-to-channel-variant selection. Providers omitted from this map consider all eligible variants; explicitly select standard to restrict a provider to its standard variant. Keys must belong to only when only is supplied ('official' alias is resolved before whitelist validation). Explicitly selected unknown or unavailable variants never fall back to another variant of the same provider.

MaxCost.description: Whole-job authorization limit in USD, up to 9223372036854.775807. Omission uses the highest single-attempt user price upper bound among admission candidates. One Job hold is shared across attempts, never summed; an explicit limit does not reserve its whole amount. New Jobs charge only the successfully delivered result and release unused funds at the terminal state. Failed and late upstream costs are absorbed by Yir without additional customer charges. Routes exceeding the existing hold or authorization are skipped. Below-primary limits are rejected. Historical jobs retain their recorded billing terms.

parameter_notices.description: Expected primary-channel handling; actual handling is reported by the successful Job.

requires_max_cost.description: True when a selectable usage-based route requires an explicit max_cost of at least USD 0.01 at Submit. This is an authorization requirement, not an estimated price or guaranteed upper bound.

supply.description: Request-specific supply suitability without internal supply details. Available supply has an empty issues array; requires_max_cost indicates that Submit needs an explicit authorization cap for usage-based charging. No matching supply returns available=false and no_matching_supply, with primary/max unavailable. Authentication, invalid requests, and infrastructure failures remain errors.

single_attempt_upper_bound.description: Largest verified single-attempt customer charge ceiling among the currently selectable routes. One Job freezes one amount shared by its attempts. Null when any selectable route lacks a verifiable upper bound; this advisory value is neither a price lock nor the customer's max_cost authorization. A verifiable ceiling can exist even when the exact charge is usage-dependent and primary/max prices are unavailable.

has_verifiable_upper_bound.description: True only when single_attempt_upper_bound is verified for all currently selectable routes. Submit resolves supply and price again. False on an unbounded provider-reported route or when supply is unavailable.

primary.description: Current preferred route's complete fixed customer price when provable, or an output-only estimate when supported by its selected tariff and model usage evidence; otherwise unavailable. An output-only estimate excludes input charges, is not a task total or authorization ceiling, and Submit rechecks current facts. The independent official reference is reported in official.

max.description: Highest complete fixed customer price among currently selectable routes when all are provable; otherwise unavailable. This price is distinct from the authorization bound, and Submit rechecks current facts.

price_difference_percent.description: Optional comparison with the official reference. Negative values mean a lower Yir price. Complete fixed prices are compared only with complete fixed prices. Output-only estimates are compared only when both prices use identical output assumptions; that comparison excludes input and other charges.

OutputQuoteEstimate.description: Generated output only. Input and other charges are excluded. Not an authorization ceiling.

output_megapixels.description: Billable whole output megapixels using the model's declared pixel unit; excludes input megapixels. Mutually exclusive with output_tokens.

quality.description: Reference quality used for the output estimate. Automatic or omitted quality uses the catalog's medium reference when available; this does not change generation parameters.

aspect_ratio.description: Reference aspect ratio used for the output estimate. Automatic aspect ratio uses a declared square reference when available; explicitly selected unsupported ratios remain unavailable.

parameter_notices.description: Actual handling from the successful attempt snapshot; omitted before success.

final_provider.description: Provider of the adopted result, present only for successful jobs. Does not expose candidate routes.

warnings.description: The primary result was delivered, but an optional additional result could not be delivered. Derived from frozen delivery facts; does not change Job success or authorize regeneration. Omitted when no delivery warning exists, including historical results.

ComputeCharge.description: Read-only billing facts. New Yir Cloud jobs use managed supply only. Historical jobs may retain byok/provider/external facts; these values do not enable BYOK submission.

supply_type.description: managed for new Cloud jobs; byok is retained only for historical billing records.

OfficialComparison.description: Successful jobs only. Complete fixed USD official price frozen at admission for the exact request. Savings is baseline minus all Yir charges, including recovery attempts; it may be negative. Omitted for historical jobs, dynamic prices, missing baselines and external billing.

FileUpload.description: Every new upload receives a multipart plan, and the Yir SDKs accept multipart only. Replaying a batch created before the multipart migration can still return the retired single-PUT plan, whose shape is outside this schema (type "single" with method, url, and headers); such batches cannot be resumed through the SDKs and should be created again.

ChannelParameters.description: Declared public parameter handling, separate from runtime eligibility.

version.description: Present on API responses; omitted from generated static artifacts.

ModelContractCatalog.description: Language-neutral static model contracts generated with this Standard OpenAPI release. Runtime price, health, authorization and route facts are excluded.

max_duration_by_reference_role.description: Maximum generated video duration in seconds when a reference of the keyed role is present; not input media duration.

only_provider.description: The parameter is ignored unless routing.only contains exactly this provider.

message.description: Safe static SDK warning; contains no request values.
